name: B10-0470/2025 (PfE) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a reset of the EU's partnership with Africa ahead of a summit in Angola on 24–25 November 2025. It wants aid and trade deals tied to African countries taking back their citizens who are in Europe illegally. It also asks for an audit of EU development spending, fair deals on African raw materials, and more focus on security in the Sahel and the conflict in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

- The EU should make development aid and trade deals conditional on cooperation over returning illegal migrants.
- African governments, EU companies and migrants are affected; Christians facing persecution in Nigeria are also named.
- The Parliament asks the Commission to act; the summit in Angola is the next step.
